newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained quoted at mostly steady to lower levels Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said.
No barges traded versus four barges traded Monday.
- One barge, Lifttop, St Louis, Mississippi River, this week, bid 125 percent of tariff, unchanged from Monday, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, this week, bid 155 percent, unchanged from Monday, similar, no offer.
- One barge, Illinois River, this week, bid at 135 percent, down 10 percentage points from Monday, similar, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of April, bid 145 percent, down five percentage points from Friday, offer 150 percent, down five percentage points.
- Four barges, Lacrose-Savage, upper Mississippi, bid 175 percent, down five percentage points from Friday, no offer.
